description: Per spec §2.4, onSuccessActivateScript and onSuccessDeactivateScript MUST only run if ALL creates/updates/destroys succeed. The handler currently runs them unconditionally after processing mutations, regardless of whether notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed are non-empty. Fix: before step 7, check if any not_* map is non-empty and skip activation side-effects if so.
title: sieve_set: onSuccess* fires on partial batch failure
